invariants.title: An issued invoice is immutable — mistakes are void-and-reissue, on the record.
The seller block freezes at issuance; issuing without a profile is refused with the guide sentence.
Numbers are sequential and never reused; a voided number stays burned.
Invoice timing is the freelancer's agreement — the system records, never gatekeeps terms.
No invented facts: amounts, dates and names come from the person or stay empty.
Documents are produced, never sent; the doc link views one document and nothing more.
Every write is a logged act with an actor; refusals are logged too.
Journal derivation balances: issue to AR/Revenue, receipt to Cash/Deposits, application to Deposits/AR.
